name: B10-0523/2025 (ECR) – Political situation in Myanmar including the humanitarian crisis of the Rohingya
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the political situation in Myanmar including the humanitarian crisis of the Rohingya
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for an immediate ceasefire in Myanmar and rejects the military junta's planned elections in late 2025 and early 2026, saying they cannot be free or fair. It asks for all political prisoners to be released, for aid to reach everyone, and for more sanctions and support for Rohingya refugees. It also urges other countries, especially in the region and the Gulf, to give more money and pressure the junta.

- The Parliament asks for a ceasefire, prisoner releases and new sanctions; it does not itself change any law.
- Rohingya refugees and people inside Myanmar are affected; the junta and its backers face pressure.
- The resolution is sent to the EU, the United Nations, Bangladesh and Southeast Asian countries; no vote on action follows from it.
